value: takes à before a place or activity

evidence.notes: Reflexive verb listed as s'amuser; à introduces the location or activity (s'amuser à la fête). Confidence high on the pronominal constraint, moderate on the à pattern.

value: takes à before the place or activity

evidence.notes: Source example 'Vous êtes-vous bien amusés à la fête?' shows obligatory reflexive pronoun and à + noun. Confidence high.
Pattern s' + apercevoir + de with indirect object marked by de; source usage note confirms de takes a noun or pronoun. Confidence high.

value: followed by a que-clause, not a noun

evidence.notes: Pattern s'apercevoir que + clause; contrasts with s'apercevoir de + noun. Confidence high; indicative mood of the clause not asserted.

value: takes sur before the surface or seat

evidence.notes: Source example 'Il s'assoit sur un banc' shows reflexive pronoun and sur + surface. Confidence high; sur is typical but other prepositions occur.
Usage note states the verb is used only pronominally in this sense and requires de before the thing seized. Confidence high.

value: se and en are integral and cannot be omitted

evidence.notes: Usage note states se and en are integral and gives va-t'en and allez-vous-en. Confidence high on both statements.

value: takes de before the place or person left

evidence.notes: Subjective pronominal used pronominally only; de regularly introduces the source (s'enfuir de prison). Confidence moderate-high.

value: takes à before the activity or place

evidence.notes: Source example 'Ils se sont ennuyés à la réception' shows reflexive pronoun and à + place/activity. Confidence high on pronominal use, moderate on à.
Pattern s' + entendre + avec with avec + person complement; source usage note describes the relationship with someone. Confidence high.
